theme_and_archetype.theme: Editorial Rhythm (Alternating Dark and Light sections)
theme_and_archetype.rationale: CCDP aims to feel like a prestigious university combined with a modern tech company and premium creative brand. This requires 'Old Money Tech' aesthetics: extreme whitespace, high-contrast structural typography (Swiss), and cinematic, moody, and deep colors (Luxury). We avoid the standard non-profit/education template by utilizing 'Godly-level' design patterns: tactical asymmetry, oversized display text, and rhythmic color blocking.

primary.name: Deep Crimson Red
primary.usage: Primary brand moments, main CTA buttons, dynamic accents. Use sparingly to maintain luxury feel. Do not use for large backgrounds unless it's a dramatic hero/impact section.

base_light.name: Cream & Charcoal
base_light.usage: Used for content-heavy sections like Programs, Mission, and Curriculum to ensure maximum legibility and an editorial 'magazine' feel.

base_dark.name: Charcoal & Cream
base_dark.usage: Used for immersive, cinematic sections like the Hero, Technology ecosystem, Impact stats, and Footer.

accent.name: Warm Gold
accent.usage: Highlights only. Small icons, subtle underlines, or numeric stat highlights. Do NOT use as a background color for large elements.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-[5rem] leading-[0.95] tracking-tighter font-medium
scale.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl leading-none tracking-tight font-medium
scale.label: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold

rules: Headings MUST use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) and reduced line-height (leading-none or leading-[0.95]).
Labels/Overlines MUST be uppercase with very wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use optical alignment. Do not center everything. Align left for authority, use asymmetrical staggering for creativity.
Max width for body copy: max-w-2xl to maintain readability.

grids.editorial_bento: Asymmetrical layouts. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix col-span-4, col-span-8, col-span-12.
grids.control_room: For Tech section: tight gaps (gap-4), strict col-span alignment, full height cards.

rules: Generous spacing: Use 2-3x more whitespace than typical designs.
Rhythm: Alternate between base_light and base_dark sections.
Mobile-first: All grids stack to col-span-1 on mobile.

navigation.style: Sticky glassmorphism. backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-[#121212]/70 border-b border-black/5 dark:border-white/5.
navigation.layout: Flex space-between. Logo left, Desktop Links center, Apply CTA right. Hidden hamburger on desktop.
navigation.interaction: Hover states on links: text color shifts to Crimson Red. Smooth transition.

buttons.primary: bg-[#990000] text-white hover:bg-[#7A0000] transition-colors rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium text-sm tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-black/20 dark:border-white/20 text-current hover:border-[#990000] hover:text-[#990000] transition-colors rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium text-sm tracking-wide
buttons.text_link: group inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-medium hover:text-[#990000] transition-colors. Add a small arrow that translates right on hover.

cards.program_card: Minimalist. Solid bg with 1px subtle border. No heavy drop shadows. Hover: -translate-y-1, border darkens, subtle ambient shadow. Inner padding: p-8 or p-10.
cards.tech_card: Grid border style. border-r border-b border-white/10. Sharp corners or max rounded-md. 'Terminal/Tactile' aesthetic.

footer.style: Dark background. py-24 md:py-32. Multi-column grid.
footer.typography: Massive brand text 'CCDP' at the bottom (text-[15vw] leading-none text-white/5).

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling if possible. Reveal elements on scroll (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y 20px to 0).
motion_and_interactions.hover: Buttons and links must have clear, elegant transitions. Use transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease.
motion_and_interactions.micro: Animated stat counters for the Impact section. Marquee for Partners section (slow, smooth drift).

rules: Hero image MUST use a gradient overlay for text readability. e.g., bg-black/40.
Images should feel cinematic, moody, and highly professional.
All logos must be pure white (in dark sections) or pure black (in light sections) to maintain a premium look.

Home.content: Headline: 'Creating the Future of Creative Careers'. Subheadline: 'Education. Technology. Community. Opportunity.' CTAs: 'Apply Now' (Primary), 'Partner With Us' (Secondary). Background: Cinematic Image overlay with black/40.
Home.layout: Center aligned content. Full viewport height (h-screen).

Home.content: Large, bold editorial typography defining the CCDP philosophy.
Home.layout: Massive left-aligned text. Minimal UI. Max-w-5xl.

Home.content: 12 Creative Pathways: Music Business, Music Production, Songwriting, Audio Engineering, Film & Television, Animation, Graphic Design, Content Creation, Photography, Creative Entrepreneurship, Marketing, AI for Creatives.
Home.layout: Bento/Grid structure. 1px borders, generous padding. Clean cards.

Home.content: Showcase ANCR, Vaulta, Culta, and future student platforms.
Home.layout: Control Room grid. Sharp, technical aesthetic. Dark mode exclusively. Use dashboard-style illustrations or tech_office image.
Side-by-side: Giant stats (Gold accent) next to clean portrait cards.
Slow continuous Marquee. Low contrast/grayscale logos. Massive padding.
Deep Crimson Red background. Bold typography.

Home.content: Social links, newsletter signup (static form), privacy/terms.
Home.layout: Multi-column grid, giant 'CCDP' text watermark at the bottom.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast ratios. Especially for text over hero images.
accessibility_and_testing.focus: All interactive elements MUST have focus states: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#990000] focus:ring-offset-2.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-apply-btn', data-testid='program-card-music').
